     9	/-!
    10	# Hartshorne IV.1: finite support of curve divisors
    11	
    12	This file gives the support API for the finite formal-sum model of curve
    13	divisors.  The geometric point type is kept explicit in the statements, while
    14	the proofs use the finite-support API already provided by `Finsupp`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory
    22	open AlgebraicGeometry
    23	
    24	namespace Hartshorne
    25	
    26	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    27	variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
    28	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]
    29	
    30	namespace CurveDivisor
    31	
    32	section
    33	  classical
    34	
    35	/-- The finite set of non-generic points occurring in a curve divisor. -/
    36	abbrev support (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
    37	    Finset {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left} :=
    38	  (show PointDivisor X.left from D).support
    39	
    40	@[simp]
    41	theorem mem_support_iff {D : CurveDivisor k X}
    42	    (p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) :
    43	    p ∈ support D ↔ coeffAt p.2 D ≠ 0 := by
    44	  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff
    45	
    46	theorem support_add_subset (D E : CurveDivisor k X) :
    47	    ∀ p, p ∈ support (D + E) → p ∈ support D ∨ p ∈ support E := by
    48	  intro p hp
    49	  classical
    50	  exact Finset.mem_union.mp (Finsupp.support_add hp)
    51	
    52	theorem support_sub_subset (D E : CurveDivisor k X) :
    53	    ∀ p, p ∈ support (D - E) → p ∈ support D ∨ p ∈ support E := by
    54	  intro p hp
    55	  classical
    56	  exact Finset.mem_union.mp (Finsupp.support_sub hp)
    57	
    58	theorem support_neg_eq (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
    59	    support (-D) = support D := by
    60	  exact Finsupp.support_neg D
    61	
    62	theorem support_single_subset
    63	    (p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) (n : ℤ) :
    64	    support (Finsupp.single p n : CurveDivisor k X) ⊆ {p} := by
    65	  classical
    66	  exact Finsupp.support_single_subset
    67	
    68	theorem support_single_ne_zero
    69	    (p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left}) {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    70	    support (Finsupp.single p n : CurveDivisor k X) = {p} := by
    71	  classical
    72	  exact Finsupp.support_single p hn
    73	
    74	@[simp]
    75	theorem support_zero : support (0 : CurveDivisor k X) = ∅ := by
    76	  exact Finsupp.support_zero
    77	
    78	@[simp]
    79	theorem support_eq_empty_iff (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
    80	    support D = ∅ ↔ D = 0 := by
    81	  exact Finsupp.support_eq_empty
    82	
    83	theorem support_nonempty_iff (D : CurveDivisor k X) :
    84	    (support D).Nonempty ↔ D ≠ 0 := by
    85	  exact Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff

    87	end classical
